_what: Every check in curation/liu_42585110, made to fail on purpose. Section 6: a new check is not done until it has.

folder_untouched_by_the_suite.what: F-069. Every mutated copy ran in a temp directory. These sha256s are of the REAL folder's tracked artifacts, before and after the suite.

seeds.why: A seed suite with no clean control credits every seed, including the ones that fire for the wrong reason.
If the anchor generator may import the enumerator's assembly library, the anchor can be built by the code it checks -- F-013 and F-037 in one line.

seeds.why: The seeded head arm is 1-methyl-3-hydroxypropyl instead of 4-hydroxybutyl: SAME molecular formula, SAME exact mass to 0.000000 Da, different connectivity. Formula and mass checks are blind to it; only the full InChIKey sees it. That is what C10 exists for.

isomass_check.note: The seeded defect is INVISIBLE to formula and to exact mass and visible only to the InChIKey. That is what proves the gate tests connectivity.

seeds.why: 13-cis and all-trans retinoic acid are isobaric to 0.000000 Da and share an InChIKey skeleton block. Nothing else in this pipeline can tell them apart, so the E/Z assertion is the only thing standing between the corpus and three identical lipids under three different names.
